主线

按当天讨论热度与互动整理；中文为意译，英文为原句节选。

1. 币安史上最大黑客事件：~$5.7–6.3B 被盗、Lazarus 指向与拨备赔付

过去 24 小时主导叙事。多源称币安相关钱包异常流出约 $57–63 亿，调查机构将矛头指向朝鲜 Lazarus/TraderTraitor；币安称已用公司资金拨备超 $63.4 亿覆盖用户损失（其中约 $50 亿为被盗同种资产）。特朗普、CFTC 安全监管议题同步升温。数字口径因来源而异，以下原帖为准。

🇨🇳 币安称已拨备超 63.4 亿美元公司资金覆盖黑客损失，其中约 50 亿已持有被盗同种代币资产，其余正通过场内与 OTC 买入，并称正与 FBI、特勤局合作。

“UPDATE: 🚨 Binance says it has already set aside over $6.34B in company funds, with $5B held in the exact stolen token assets and the remaining assets being bought through market and OTC channels. It also says it has con…”

— @CoinMarketCap · 原帖

🇨🇳 WatcherGuru：朝鲜对币安 63 亿美元加密货币黑客案，被称为人类史上最大劫案。

“JUST IN: 🇰🇵 North Korea's $6,300,000,000 Binance crypto hack is the largest heist in human history.”

— @WatcherGuru · 原帖

🇨🇳 Bitcoin Magazine：TRM Labs 指朝鲜精英黑客单位 TraderTraitor 对 63 亿美元币安黑客负责，正式成为史上最大加密黑客案。

“JUST IN: Blockchain investigators at TRM Labs say North Korea’s elite hacking unit, TraderTraitor, is responsible for the $6.3 billion Binance hack 👀 It’s officially the largest crypto hack in history.”

— @BitcoinMagazine · 原帖

🇨🇳 Michael Saylor：币安已承诺用自身资产负债表让客户不受损；他预计会兑现，行业将从中吸取教训、加强安全。

“Binance has committed its own balance sheet to making customers whole. I expect it to deliver. Our industry will learn from this incident, strengthen security, and emerge stronger and more resilient.”

— @saylor · 原帖

2. 稳定币发行方冻结与执法介入：超约 $26 亿被冻、特勤局联手 Circle

黑客冲击下，Tether、Circle 等发行方迅速冻结相关稳定币；美特勤局、FBI 介入追踪与追回。部分资金据报道已在 DEX 兑换为 ETH 等较难冻结资产，遏制并不完整。市场同时出现大规模清算。

🇨🇳 WatcherGuru：美国特勤局正与 Circle 合作，识别、冻结并追回从币安被盗资金。

“JUST IN: 🇺🇸 US Secret Service is working with Circle to identify, freeze, and recover funds stolen from Binance.”

— @WatcherGuru · 原帖

🇨🇳 Decrypt：特勤局与 FBI 加入币安黑客调查，Circle 冻结约 8.23 亿美元。

“Secret Service, FBI Join Binance Hack Probe as Circle Freezes $823 Million”

— @DecryptMedia · 原帖

🇨🇳 Cointelegraph：过去 24 小时加密清算达 16 亿美元，单笔最大约 1109 万美元出现在币安。

“🚨 REKT: Crypto liquidations hit $1.6B in 24 hours, with the largest single order worth $11.09M on Binance.”

— @Cointelegraph · 原帖

3. BTC/ETH 风险偏好回落与机构侧对冲叙事（ETF、Strategy、$MSTR）

黑客冲击下 BTC 多被报道跌破约 8 万美元区间；同时仍有 ETF 产品与 Strategy/$MSTR 成交活跃等「机构未完全离场」叙事。Franklin Templeton 推出两只含比特币敞口的新 ETF 也被高频转发。

🇨🇳 Bitcoin Magazine：约 1.8 万亿美元规模的 Franklin Templeton 推出两只新比特币 ETF（FBEQ、FIBT），称持仓约 95% 股票 + 5% 比特币，并将股票股息再投资比特币。

“JUST IN: 🇺🇸 $1.8 trillion Franklin Templeton has launched two new Bitcoin ETFs, giving holders 95% exposure to stocks and 5% to Bitcoin. The 'FBEQ' and 'FIBT' ETFs will reinvest stock dividends into Bitcoin! 🚀”

— @BitcoinMagazine · 原帖

🇨🇳 Bitcoin Archive：Michael Saylor 的 Strategy 当日成交额已达约 33 亿美元，超过 Dell、ASML、Netflix、Visa 等当日成交，称 $MSTR「入座」。

“Michael Saylor’s Strategy traded $3.3B in volume so far today. Dell ($270B cap) — $3.1B ASML ($600B cap) — $2.3B Netflix ($250B cap) — $2.1B Visa ($410B cap) — $1.8B $MSTR has officially earned its seat at the table.”

— @BitcoinArchive · 原帖

🇨🇳 Cointelegraph：Saylor 称预计币安会兑现用资产负债表补用户损失，并称事件是行业教训。

“🚨 JUST IN: Michael Saylor says he expects Binance to make customers whole after pledging its balance sheet to cover losses. He calls the incident a lesson for the wider crypto industry.”

— @Cointelegraph · 原帖

5. 美股科技股杀估值：苹果市值反超英伟达、纳指拖累风险资产

与加密抛售并行，美股科技股大幅回调；苹果市值约 $5.03T 反超英伟达约 $4.94T 成为转发热点。同行日报亦强调美股市值蒸发超 $2T。加密侧被当作同一风险偏好收缩的一部分。

🇨🇳 WatcherGuru：苹果正式超越英伟达成为全球市值最高公司。$AAPL 约 5.0 万亿美元，$NVDA 约 4.9 万亿美元。

6. 预测市场与合规周边：Polymarket 金银短周期盘、监管问询

Polymarket 上线金银价格短周期盘；参议员要求 Kalshi/Polymarket 说明如何防止候选人交易；另有 Kalshi 大额融资与以色列选举钱包争议等帖。

🇨🇳 WatcherGuru：Polymarket 全球上线黄金与白银价格市场，提供 15 分钟、小时与日频交易。

“JUST IN: Polymarket launches gold and silver price markets worldwide, with 15-minute, hourly and daily trading.”

— @WatcherGuru · 原帖

🇨🇳 CoinMarketCap：参议员 Warren 与 Curtis 要求 Kalshi 与 Polymarket 说明如何防止候选人及竞选内部人士交易。

“LATEST: 🇺🇸 Senators Elizabeth Warren and John Curtis are demanding Kalshi and Polymarket explain how they prevent candidates and campaign insiders from trading on election markets using nonpublic information by Nov. 3.”

— @CoinMarketCap · 原帖

🇨🇳 Cointelegraph：Polymarket 上线金银 15 分钟涨跌预测盘，并以 Chainlink 为官方预言机合作方。

“⚡️ NEW: Polymarket launches 15-minute up/down prediction markets for gold and silver, with Chainlink as its official oracle partner.”

— @Cointelegraph · 原帖

7. 交易所储备证明与托管信任：OKX 连续 48 期 PoR

黑客后「证明而非承诺」话术升温。OKX 官方发帖强调四年 48 期连续月度储备证明；CFTC 亦有加强交易所网络安全注册的提议转发热帖。注意：PoR 含交易所自评，需独立核验。

🇨🇳 OKX：四年、连续 48 期月度储备证明；称用户可自行核验储备，第 48 期报告已上线。

“Proof, not promises. Four years. 48 consecutive monthly Proof of Reserves reports. And counting. You don’t have to take our word for the reserves backing your crypto. You can verify them yourself. Report #48 is live. …”

— @okx · 原帖

🇨🇳 WatcherGuru：CFTC 提议新规，允许加密交易所注册以加强防网络攻击安全。

“JUST IN: 🇺🇸 CFTC proposes new regulations for crypto exchanges to strengthen security against cyberattacks.”

— @WatcherGuru · 原帖
